records.name: Case
records.design_term: Episode / case (DESIGN 'Mission / case / task'; SOCIAL-ASSET-MATRIX 'Work case / episode')
records.meaning: The envelope around one matter that outlives its sessions and tasks and owns a sketchbook.
records.evidence: wskernel/models.py:1070 class Episode (basis includes CASE); case.py:192 timeline, :379 learn, :416 lessons; serve.py:265 'episodes' reader. Spot check agrees with DISCOVERY O01. Missing for screens: recording and contribution relations (package adds them, does not rename Episode).

records.name: Mission
records.design_term: Mission (and proposed Campaign above it, NATIVE-ENGINE.md line 42)
records.meaning: A charged outcome that tasks and cases serve.
records.evidence: models.py:536 class Mission; serve.py:261 'missions' reader. Campaign record is proposed only (NATIVE-ENGINE.md line 42, INTEGRATION-MAP 'Destination').

records.name: Task
records.design_term: Task (execution-sized obligation links a task, DESIGN 'Obligation')
records.meaning: A unit of committed work in a state, with a holder and a disposition.
records.evidence: models.py:587 class Task; serve.py:260 'tasks' reader plus queue.claim/transition/abandon verbs. DISCOVERY O03: record write then event append is not atomic.

records.name: Session
records.design_term: Invocation / run (DEVELOPMENT-CONTRACTS 'Participant identity, invocation identity and accountable holder remain separate')
records.meaning: One running tool session bound to a task and case; coordination only, never authority.
records.evidence: models.py:1106 class Session; serve.py:264 'sessions' reader. booth_stream.py:157 card() already reads the session record to name seat and task on the live stream view.

records.name: Participant
records.design_term: Participant / principal (DESIGN 'Participant'; MATRIX 'Participation')
records.meaning: A stable human, agent or service identity that survives model changes and sessions and carries a display profile.
records.evidence: Existing pieces: Session.operator/seat/identity/actor_kind (models.py:1106), Seat enum (models.py:122), Event.actor/actor_kind (models.py:1494-1529). No record gives one person or agent a stable id across sessions; the package says identity binding is T03 work.

records.name: Agent behavior profile
records.design_term: Behavior profile / behavior core (MATRIX 'Agent participation'; STATE-ENGINE-INTEGRATION item 4)
records.meaning: A versioned description of how an agent seat chooses among permitted actions, bound to a model, which never adds permission.
records.evidence: Existing pieces: .claude/agents/*.md (eight perspectives: charge, closure, controller, career, communicator, coordinator, customer, contractor); delivery/host.py:45 ModelBinding (pinned model execution); repos/bdos/cores cited in IMPLEMENTATION-EVIDENCE.md line 15. None is a versioned record with digest and selection trace.

records.name: Booth session
records.design_term: Booth session (MATRIX 'Booth session'; DESIGN 'Capture and replay')
records.meaning: A named isolated browser or hidden desktop that a session drives, watches and optionally records.
records.evidence: booth.py:99 class BoothRecord. Spot check agrees with DISCOVERY O10: task and owner only, no case, session or mission scope, and name is the identity (reusable). Queued fix: workstation-ws-booth-open-records-the-calling-sessio. Booths are not a serve.py reader (serve.py:252-284).

records.name: Recording
records.design_term: Recording / capture interval (DESIGN 'Recording')
records.meaning: One captured interval with its own id, time base, tracks, coverage gaps and case link, outliving the booth process.
records.evidence: Existing pieces: booth_record.py recording home keyed by booth name (booth.py:1908 recording_home) with meta.json, frames/, recording.mp4, segments.json manifest of live segments and the real time each covers (booth_record.py:85-86, 1537), recording.stats.json. No immutable recording id, no case link, no recorded coverage gaps; cap policy can discard older media (DISCOVERY O12).

records.name: Video track
records.design_term: Track: booth video (DESIGN 'Capture and replay')
records.meaning: The frame and encoded video stream of a recording on a real-time base.
records.evidence: booth_record.py SEGMENTS/MANIFEST/FRAMES/THUMBS/VIDEO (lines 78-86), encode_video (1554); booth_watch.py serves /stream.mjpg, /frames.json, /segments.json, /segments/<i>.mp4, /thumbs (lines 14-27, 308-319). Missing: track id and recording id; addressed only through a booth's loopback port.

records.name: Event track
records.design_term: Track: browser event reconstruction and tool/API events
records.meaning: Timed actions and DOM events that can be replayed or drawn as cards without video.
records.evidence: booth_record.py:111 LOGGED = goto, click, drag, type, key, upload (read verbs excluded, agrees with O11); append_action (158) writes actions.jsonl with its own writer, not the locked event log; recording.rrweb.jsonl (RRWEB, line 76). Session-level tool calls are Events with input/output digests only (ops/session_ops.py:3132-3133), which cannot reconstruct content (REVIEW 'Contradictions').

records.name: Terminal track
records.design_term: Track: terminal output (DESIGN 'Capture and replay'; PRODUCTION 'Terminal activity can become timed visual material')
records.meaning: Timed terminal text output from a run, renderable as a track.
records.evidence: Not found as a track. Nearest pieces: a desktop booth can show a console window only as video and refuses unproven console hosts (booth.py:526 CONSOLE_UNPROVEN, :1185 console_host_proven); console_terminal.py is the B-DOS terminal adapter with no capture; hook observations store digests, not text.

records.name: Artifact track
records.design_term: Track: artifacts (DESIGN 'Capture and replay'; PRODUCTION P01)
records.meaning: Artifact versions produced during a recording, placed on its timeline.
records.evidence: Existing pieces: artifacts.py mirror of published claude.ai artifacts (entry.json with version, control/artifacts/mirror/<id>); Handoff.changed_files and VerificationReceipt.evidence (models.py:865, 937); delivery/storage.py:171 resolve() over addressed, digested versions. None is placed on a recording's timeline.

records.name: Narration line
records.design_term: Not named in the package (exists in kernel); closest to caption/voiceover track
records.meaning: A line of text a session posts to a booth while it works, shown as a live subtitle.
records.evidence: booth_record.py:87 NARRATION narration.jsonl, :206 append_narration (ws booth say); booth_stream.py:111 subtitles merges actions and narration; booth_watch.py /subtitles.json. The package's DISCOVERY does not list it (O11 names actions, rrweb, frames/video, cuts, timing). Not versioned; not a caption track.

records.name: Anchor
records.design_term: Anchor (recording_id, track_id, source_event_id or source_offset, source_version) (DESIGN 'Capture and replay')
records.meaning: An immutable pointer to a source moment that survives re-cuts.
records.evidence: No anchor record. Existing mechanism it would use: booth_record.py:994 cut_time and :1006 real_time map edited time to real time (O12); booth_record.py:604 parse_t reads ?t= deep links in edited-player seconds, which is the fragile form E27 warns against.

records.name: Contribution
records.design_term: Contribution (DESIGN 'Contribution'; MATRIX 'Prime unit')
records.meaning: A versioned, addressable addition by an author to a scope, with audience, from which publications, messages and comments are composed.
records.evidence: DISCOVERY O18 bounded negative search; my search of wskernel found no contribution model (models.py class list lines 21-1691).

records.name: Relationship
records.design_term: Relationship (reply-to, evidences, supersedes, about, addresses, follows, classifies, resolves)
records.meaning: A typed, provenance-carrying link between two references that never confers a grant.
records.evidence: No general typed relation record. Nearest: links.py and control/config/links.json (repository links), Candidate.superseded_by (models.py:835). Neither is a social relation.

records.name: Comment
records.design_term: Comment (anchored) (DESIGN 'Distinct communication behavior')
records.meaning: A contribution replying to exactly one parent version or source anchor.
records.evidence: O18; no comment model. Judgement.note (models.py:705) is an owner verdict note on a task/case, not a comment.

records.name: Message
records.design_term: Message (DESIGN 'Distinct communication behavior')
records.meaning: A contribution addressed to explicit recipients with delivery states kept apart from read and acknowledged.
records.evidence: No message record. Adjacent: delivery/gmail.py:136 feedback_payload turns inbound email into a broker event (ingress only); peer sessions message each other through sketchbook pages and commit ids, which are not records.

records.name: Reaction
records.design_term: Reaction (DESIGN 'Distinct communication behavior')
records.meaning: One current reaction per actor, target and kind, with history, that grants and settles nothing.
records.evidence: O18; not found. Judgement verdicts (keep/park/drop/unclear) are owner opinions on work items, a different meaning.

records.name: Publication / edition
records.design_term: Publication; rendered edition (PRODUCTION 'Production model')
records.meaning: A published contribution with audience and lineage back to source and edit versions; an edition is one rendered form of it.
records.evidence: Not found as a record. Adjacent: delivery/gmail.py:28 SentEdition (id, subject, thread_id, message_id, sent_at) records mailroom email editions for feedback binding; artifacts.py mirrors published claude.ai artifacts. Neither holds audience, sources or lineage.

records.name: Clip
records.design_term: Not a separate term; a publication selecting intervals (DESIGN 'Publication'; H15, H23)
records.meaning: A shareable selected range of one or more recordings with its own id.
records.evidence: No clip record. The replay player accepts a start time (booth_record.py:604 parse_t), which is a link, not an addressable clip.

records.name: Edit manifest
records.design_term: Edit manifest / cut (DESIGN 'Capture and replay'; PRODUCTION 'Assemble')
records.meaning: A versioned mapping from presentation time to source intervals across one or more recordings.
records.evidence: booth_record.py:924 edit_cut and :675 make_cut write one automatic cut.json per recording from action and frame-change analysis; cut_time/real_time map both ways. Single-source, machine-made, overwritten, not versioned or authored.

records.name: Source manifest
records.design_term: Source manifest (PRODUCTION 'Production model')
records.meaning: The recording intervals, event ranges, artifact versions and restrictions an editorial project may draw on.
records.evidence: Not found; no cross-recording selection exists.

records.name: Voiceover / caption track
records.design_term: Scripts, voiceovers, captions, translations as separate versioned tracks (PRODUCTION)
records.meaning: A versioned narration, audio or caption track aligned to an edit manifest version, marking evidence apart from interpretation.
records.evidence: Existing pieces: narration.jsonl (booth_record.py:206) and machine captions per action (booth_record.py:329 caption_for, :311 overlay_for). No versioning, audio, alignment to a cut version, or evidence marking.

records.name: Evaluation / review
records.design_term: Review / evaluation (DESIGN 'Review'; MATRIX 'Review / community support')
records.meaning: An assertion-by-assertion result on a frozen subject by an independent reviewer, which can be disputed without being rewritten.
records.evidence: Existing pieces: Candidate frozen identity (models.py:822), VerificationReceipt (865), contract.py audit (O14: runs in task worktree, not a frozen tree; queued fix workstation-audit-runs-in-a-disposable-tree-at-the-committed-revision), Judgement (705, opinion only). Nothing reviews a publication or edition.

records.name: Obligation
records.design_term: Obligation / responsibility (DESIGN 'Obligation', 'Responsibility')
records.meaning: An owed outcome with a holder or explicit vacancy, a wake condition and settlement evidence.
records.evidence: Existing pieces: Handoff.residuals as text (models.py:952) and Reception carried/dropped-with-reason (963; reception.py account/receive, O05); Task waiting_on and state. No obligation id, so a comment cannot point at one.

records.name: Grant / ACL
records.design_term: Grant, policy, audience (MATRIX 'ACL and authority matrix')
records.meaning: An authenticated decision about who may watch, comment, edit, publish, assign or operate on a scope.
records.evidence: Existing pieces: github/authority.py (permissions per authority, need_within), delivery/storage.py:94 _grants via an injected authorize callback (refuses AUTHORITY_UNCONFIGURED/DENIED), the session write guard (task binding). No audience or read ACL on any record or media.

records.name: Subscription / follow
records.design_term: Subscription (DESIGN 'Subscription': social follow vs workflow trigger)
records.meaning: A participant's versioned selection of what activity reaches them, kept apart from workflow triggers.
records.evidence: delivery/broker.py:11 subscribe(id, topic, workflow, version, actor, now, enabled) stores workflow subscriptions with exact topic match (O06). That is the trigger half; no social follow of a person, topic or mission.

records.name: Feed projection
records.design_term: Projection (feed, profile, topic page, inbox) with input cursor and policy version (DESIGN 'Objects and ownership')
records.meaning: A regenerable, access-filtered view with a cursor and a stated reason for each item.
records.evidence: No feed. Adjacent projections that are not access-filtered feeds: ws status (control/generated), judgement_ops.discovery_rows (serve.py:272 'board'), priority rows (serve.py:280), case.timeline scans (O04).

records.name: Notification / delivery

Spot check agrees with O06/O07. Missing: outbound notification to a person, channel, read and acknowledged states.

records.meaning: One attributed change to a stateful record with scope frozen at write time.
records.evidence: models.py:1506 class Event, scope never recomputed (D-0084); ops/event_ops.py append. Not transactional with the record write (O03).

records.name: Topic
records.design_term: Topic / theme relation with origin human|declared-rule|model-proposed (DESIGN 'Distinct communication behavior')

open_decisions: D1 canonical storage: whether admitted continuity records move to a transactional SQLite store, which needs a narrow R-29 amendment by Bdo; otherwise a journaled JSON authority (STRATEGY.md line 60; REVIEW.md 'Outstanding decisions' row 1; SCALING.md line 48).
D2 deployed policy: audiences, recording consent and retention, spend ceilings, autonomous effect classes, channels (PROVING-AND-DELIVERY.md line 70; STRATEGY.md line 62).
Capture, privacy and retention classes and measured storage rates (REVIEW.md 'Outstanding decisions' row 2; DESIGN.md 'Boundaries that stay visible').
Which event classes may trigger agents under standing authority, and per-role grants (DESIGN.md 'Boundaries that stay visible'; REVIEW.md row 3).
Mobile, email and push provider choices and credentials (REVIEW.md row 4; T14).
Feed ranking preference weights and chronological default; no engagement-only optimisation (DESIGN.md 'Boundaries'; REVIEW.md row 5).
Execution capacity limits: no supported concurrency number yet (REVIEW.md row 6; SCALING.md line 110).
Cross-host identity: Codex/Claude/script capture parity and independence enforcement (REVIEW.md row 7).
Contracts of adjacent systems (Soveraeign authority, mailroom) before cross-repo changes (REVIEW.md row 8; INTEGRATION-MAP.md rows for Soveraeign and mailroom).
Which outcome judgements stay personal and who may settle them (DESIGN.md 'Boundaries'; STRATEGY.md line 62).
Authority bootstrap: owner-enrolled root and key rotation procedure (STRATEGY.md line 64; T03).
Campaign as a new versioned domain record over missions: proposed, not adopted (NATIVE-ENGINE.md line 42; INTEGRATION-MAP.md 'Destination').
Cross-organisation federation/trust contract left as an extension point (REVIEW.md 'Composition test').
Unity binding route: supported on paper, not implemented or qualified (NATIVE-ENGINE.md line 38).
Carried discrepancy: a booth task says 24 fps while source captures at 60 and views at 24 (DISCOVERY.md 'Existing work to retain'; booth_record.py lines 65-66 agree with the source reading).
